title: AI基础设施整合与治理并进：云厂商竞逐平台化Agent生态与可持续算力
core_insight: 云厂商正加速AI基础设施整合，从推理架构统一、Agent执行环境优化到可持续算力布局，竞争焦点从底层资源转向平台化AI治理与行业应用深化

dimension_texts.technology: Google Cloud推出GKE Inference Gateway统一实时与异步推理架构，Cloudflare发布Dynamic Workers实现AI代码安全沙箱执行速度提升100倍，标志云原生AI基础设施的重要演进 AWS推出ECS Managed Daemons优化容器编排，Azure SQL深度集成AI能力，Gemma 4作为最强大开源模型发布，Envoy网络为Agentic AI提供新基础 Run real-time and async inference on the same infrastructure with GKE Inference Gateway Sandboxing AI agents, 100x faster Announcing managed daemon support for Amazon ECS Managed Instances Advancing agentic AI with Microsoft databases across a unified data estate Introducing Gemma 4 on Google Cloud: Our most capable open models yet Envoy: A future-ready foundation for agentic AI networking How we use Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) to turn Workflows code into visual diagrams Why we're rethinking cache for the AI era Announcing Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL serverless database creation in seconds Launching Cloudflare’s Gen 13 servers: trading cache for cores for 2x edge compute performance
dimension_texts.infrastructure: AWS推出可持续性控制台整合碳排放报告，Google Cloud发布Veo 3.1 Lite优化AI服务成本，火山引擎强调极致性价比云战略 AI公司投资天然气电厂应对算力需求，Cloudflare Gen 13服务器采用AMD EPYC Turin处理器提升边缘性能，微软与NVIDIA深化AI基础设施合作 Announcing the AWS Sustainability console: Programmatic access, configurable CSV reports, and Scope 1–3 reporting in one place AI companies are building huge natural gas plants to power data centers.
